create_language_encoder: create a LanguageEncoder instance with a config object and d_model dimension for text encoding
build_clip_text_encoder: build a LanguageEncoder using the CLIP text encoder backed by openai/clip-vit-base-patch32
build_roberta_text_encoder: build a LanguageEncoder using the RoBERTa text encoder backed by roberta-base
run_language_encoder_forward: run the LanguageEncoder forward pass on a list of text strings to get projected features and attention masks
freeze_encoder_backbone: freeze the LanguageEncoder text encoder backbone parameters so they are not trained
